the following questions: (i) how to effectively search and explore biomedical literature and health-centric contents in terms of entities and categories, (ii) how to perform analytics over such contents, and (iii) how to support entity-based information needs in the health domain, by integrating large knowledge bases and leveraging entity linking methods.
